result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, I'd recommend **Freshdesk or Help Scout** as the starting point. Both offer a good balance of ease of use, ticket management, automation, and affordability without requiring a dedicated IT administrator.

The best choice depends on whether you primarily handle email support, need omnichannel support, or want a more sophisticated ticketing system.

## Best help desk software for small teams

![Top Free Customer Service Software in 2026 - Freshworks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5E2r2AcnIDT8zxLIiBADz7hJ8MoDzh_ulTvFG_8pkN5lnYNePkWR9wfYBeU0JTCyXfieSrXS13FyL6gvZXQBafGdl1pgWMvhtSXXYb4lkixcjz35s8nCMtgLbBtCtMUBB-S50yzPR2WJ7cFRTyIsXX65wwHU3s7ubgQYwXkEN4rZ-JrQ3s4HUtiKIs0TK67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

- Email ticketing, assignment and prioritisation
- Automation and canned responses
- Knowledge base and AI features
- Good balance of functionality and scalability

**Indicative price\:** From \$19/agent/month on annual billing for Growth.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![help-scout-dashboard | CompareCamp.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLSW2sckvz5fS5dKHzxI7i1P4U6caKgoxViEoufvLa1lZiCqP3V3cipygU7VatBebc7VF7_lZVKdb9KP4WqKQpz7Mk8c6l62yFfiCOpw6-zdo0ved7fT5oVptW9KcshYPmiX9UEdmd-FXUxaPpavSNuz3ELCTHYtOzTJhWwFaOJ5I4BLnDVw5M6lEeAKajbP?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

- Shared inbox that feels like email
- Easy collaboration between agents
- Customer conversation history
- Knowledge base and self-service

**Indicative price\:** Free plan for up to five users; paid plans from \$25/user/month annually.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Insights do atendimento ao cliente acionáveis por meio de painéis | Zoho Desk](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZBrmRjtO90K6sKVWrIXxtNhWyAupg5CFOMNFXiGRdfp5ix0Dzkua5bHv7Qo5RojkxiyAd3tBP8BtSAd77M5-MiPwslaaThKStVVWGd8GWBF_N37V6r_Ygf6Fn-IxtqkoLXZx9xtQOoQcbm5IeVgJV0Bq_WOsM09u_2HGeiyItgevaz4sJT3M2mX8iw2pKbYr?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable ticket management
- Automation and workflow rules
- Integrates with Zoho CRM
- Good reporting capabilities

**Indicative price\:** Free tier for up to three agents; paid entry plans from around \$7–14/user/month, depending on edition.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![The best knowledge management tools and software of 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9dRtGQkfHArV0qIUaMWtPwDAxph36M6uyMuJuYL5Nb37GYEL9OdgfA0y1SNI6GOCC9-ae4-4860oiRZ2fZTFs48UXJuCz7bjH0jhWvEac0wMvUdn1t5unetf766UEuVzUe2st232UT4vnSjPa9U7Q4SzUXwjP-KAf8Qxx9_EHJ58RkWo6BtC72Rk2Isr08OK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

(Best for scaling)

- Advanced ticket routing
- Strong reporting and analytics
- Multiple support channels
- Extensive integrations and customisation

**Indicative price\:** Suite plans from around \$55/agent/month annually.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.com/)

---

![Explore the best website designs on Mobbin](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/of6Yx-EPrrEoz4moVMSfcfcxs2OHo1w6jLojBc0Zks18nIjqpSiy0W0_73IwY5fIFCr-QiZNJna_lUg2R_2Xe361RX9foheE7rADOFeelA0aStA-tteIX8lGxwhmQBq0syp7-zfPKfmvOk3tjjQmsZ5pOIbaQpOFl16sSp_-ZTICqHp7S6iaenYXy2pGsEi1?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

(Best for live chat and AI)

- Website and in-app messaging
- AI support agent
- Automated customer conversations
- Particularly useful for SaaS businesses

**Indicative price\:** From around \$29/seat/month annually, with additional AI resolution costs.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

These are indicative starting prices, not directly equivalent plan prices. Features, limits, billing terms and AI charges vary. ## My recommendation

For most small support teams, I'd shortlist these three\:

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| 2–10 agents, general customer support | Freshdesk |
| 2–10 agents, mostly email support | Help Scout |
| Very tight budget | Zoho Desk |


I wouldn't start with Zendesk unless you already know you need complex workflows, advanced reporting or multiple support channels.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can make a much more precise recommendation if I know a little about your team.
